methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: there is proposed management process according to ISO 50001 connected with the dynamic activities and systems that are affected specifically by the environment and focus of the management groups

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Public-sector/local-government energy management framework proposal per ISO 50001; energy performance is treated only organisationally. No EnPI or EnB model is identified or characterised (no normalisation variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach); the 'reference level' concept is invoked conceptually only.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The monitored local territory has area 8,974 km2, in which are 126 schools and school facilities, 27 social facilities and 28 cultural facilities

stage1.notes: Crux Tier-1 call is eligibility: a 'reference level'/'reference value' (EnB-like) is invoked (pp.1,5,7) but never characterised (no variables/functional form/construction method), so it fails the v2.3 identify-and-characterise bar; deliverable is a qualitative public-sector management framework. paper_type coded as single-organisation study of one local government (framework/theoretical is the alternative).
